name: do_not_use_jsx_elementchildrenattribute_0e371c4b
subject: fix: do not use `JSX.ElementChildrenAttribute` under `jsx: react-jsx` or `jsx: react-jsxdev` (#60880)

triage.label: bug
triage.reason: Under jsx react-jsx and react-jsxdev, the checker looked up JSX.ElementChildrenAttribute, which should not apply in those modes. It now returns the fixed 'children' property name for those modes.
